text_block_list.text:
One day, King Halo received
a fan letter.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh, fan letters, huh?
Well, I'll take care of them for you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start the meeting.
After all, that's what we gathered for today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fan mail for me!
Fan mail just for me! Ufufu~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, I've been waiting forever for this!
Well then, let's get right to it~... ♪"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King-chan.
You're all smiles today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! U-Urara-san?!
When did you get back?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sakki—! Hey hey, who's that letter from?
I wanna see too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, why not~? Let me seeee!
Please, please, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No matter how much you beg, it's a no!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a letter that a fan
took the time out of their day to write just for me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I want to take those feelings seriously,
one-on-one, and accept them."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As a treasure that belongs only to me.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get it at first, but now I do!
It's a super important letter, isn't it!
